item.title: EXCUSE ME in Korean — SweetandtastyTV
item.description: This week on KWOW, we learn the various ways to say EXCUSE ME in Korean. We begin with 실례합니다 (shil-lae-hap-ni-da). Let’s say you’re walking through a crowded street and you’re trying to get by: 실례합니다! Excuse me! Or maybe someone is blocking your way while you exit the subway train: 실례합니다! Excuse me!
